summary: Improve risk selection, pricing rationale, referrals, and portfolio review through advanced underwriting case exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Insurance underwriting evaluates submissions to decide whether to accept a risk and on what terms. For underwriters, managers, and portfolio analysts, this course builds a repeatable approach to assessing exposure and loss evidence, aligning coverage and pricing, and making decisions within risk appetite and delegated authority. You practise referrals, exception documentation, and portfolio analysis, with conceptual coverage of AI-assisted triage and model governance.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is designed for insurance professionals who make or review risk acceptance decisions, manage underwriting authority, or analyse portfolio performance.
prerequisites: Prior professional experience reviewing insurance submissions, policy terms, or underwriting decisions is expected. No coding or programming is required.
